declined.subject: native-shell-integration
declined.reason: The subject 'native-shell-integration' governs multi-platform client-side desktop shells wrapping a web/document presentation layer inside a native host process (window focus custody, overlays, accessibility tree queries, OS permission gates, input chord synthesis). Context 'grants-intelligence' is a suite of headless backend scraping and data ingestion crates (grants-common, grants-gov, ca-grants, eu-sedia, cordis) with no client UI, windowing runtime, or native desktop shell integration. Per seat instructions prohibiting not-applicable, the pair is declined.
